summary: The operator of the Defi Degens group charged a 750 dollar entry fee and solicited members to invest in private sales for three claimed projects with promised airdrops after launch. The users reported receiving no project updates for six months after investing.
user_mistake: invested in private token sales promoted by the operator of a paid online group
prevention: Confirm independently that a token project and private sale are genuine before sending funds / Do not fund private sales based solely on claims from a group operator
